lines.en: label springtime11:
scene ayanemakxmastalk1
: What if...you get rid of {i}life transference{/i} and...trade it for something more...offensive instead?...
lines.zh: 如果……你把{i}生命转移{/i}去掉，换成更……有攻击性的法术呢？……

lines.en: : Like...if you’re going to be...on the front lines...maybe {i}spirit guardians{/i} would be good?...
lines.zh: 比如……既然你要……站在最前线……也许{i}守护灵魂{/i}会好一点？……

lines.en: : No one else in the party ever heals. So either I stock up on spells that do that, or everyone starts playing less selfishly.
lines.zh: 队里根本没别人会治疗。所以要么我多准备点治疗法术，要么大家别打得那么自私。

lines.en: : But...that spell...damages you as well, doesn’t it?...Isn’t that a little too risky for...a boss fight as big as Molly is making this out to be...
lines.zh: 可是……那个法术……也会伤到你自己吧？……Molly 把这场 boss 战说得那么夸张，用这个是不是太冒险了……

lines.en: : It should be fine so long as we can get the boss to focus on you instead. If only you still had that second arm. I feel like that would be a big help here.
lines.zh: 只要我们能让 boss 转而盯着你就没问题。要是你那条胳膊还在就好了。我觉得那在这儿能帮上大忙。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk2
: If everything...goes according to plan...I should have enough gold to buy a new one after this dungeon...
lines.zh: 如果一切……按计划进行……打完这个地下城我应该就有足够的金币买一条新的了……

lines.en: : I know I shouldn’t be questioning medical practices in a world where we can literally use magic, but that just doesn’t seem realistic or plausible to me.
lines.zh: 我知道在一个真能使用魔法的世界里质疑医疗手段是我不对，但这怎么看都不现实、也太离谱了。

lines.en: : A {i}steel{/i} arm...made by an artificer in the town Ram comes from...
lines.zh: 一条{i}钢铁{/i}手臂……由 Ram 老家那座城里的奇械师打造……

lines.en: : If...If the quality is high enough...I think it might even give me advantage on some attacks instead of...disadvantage from...there not being anything there right now...
lines.zh: 如果……如果做工够好……我觉得它说不定还能让我在某些攻击上获得优势，而不是像现在这样……因为那边什么都没有……而陷入劣势……

lines.en: : If that’s the case, why don’t all of us just have our arms torn off and replaced with better arms? It’s not like we can actually feel pain for our characters, so I see no downside to this.
lines.zh: 那样的话，我们干脆全都把手臂扯掉、换成更好的手臂不就行了？反正我们又不会真的替角色感觉到疼，我看不出有什么坏处。

lines.en: : That’s...
scene ayanemakxmastalk3
: That’s actually...not a bad idea...
lines.zh: 这其实……也不算个坏主意……

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk4
: So, now that neither one of us is {i}busy{/i} anymore, can we continue our conversation from this morning? Or do you really just not care about Maya or Sensei at all?
lines.zh: 那么，既然我们俩现在都不{i}忙{/i}了，能接着早上那次聊下去吗？还是说你真的对 Maya 和 Sensei 一点都不在乎？

lines.en: : Sensei I obviously care about. Maya? Not so much. Though, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t prefer the one who insulted me fractionally less.
lines.zh: Sensei 我当然在乎。Maya？就没那么在乎了。不过，要说我不偏向那个骂我骂得稍微轻一点的，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Plus, if her {i}untimely end{/i} is truly what caused Sensei to spiral into a pit of self-loathing and misery that only Ami is able to witness, maybe trying to “save” her {i}could{/i} be beneficial in some way.
lines.zh: 再说了，如果她的{i}早逝{/i}真是让 Sensei 坠入自我厌恶和痛苦的深渊、而只有 Ami 能看在眼里，那试着「救」她{i}也许{/i}在某些方面是有好处的。

lines.en: : I just have no idea what that way would be because this world is fucking insane and I’m starting to think I might be the protagonist of the world’s worst most convoluted romance manga.
lines.zh: 我只是完全想不出能有什么好处，因为这世界他妈的疯了，我开始觉得自己可能是全世界最烂、最绕的爱情漫画的主角。

lines.en: : It’s {i}definitely{/i} the Maya thing that’s broken Sensei. There’s not a doubt in my mind about that.
lines.zh: 把 Sensei 搞垮的{i}肯定{/i}就是 Maya 那件事。这一点我毫不怀疑。

lines.en: : Then, let me ask you this before we start coming up with some crazy plan to cure divine amnesia-
lines.zh: 那么，在我们开始想什么疯狂的计划去治疗神圣的失忆症之前，先让我问你一句——

lines.en: : If either one of {i}us{/i} was reset, do you think it would hit Sensei even remotely as hard as {i}her{/i} reset apparently hit him?
lines.zh: 如果{i}我们{/i}当中任何一个被重置了，你觉得 Sensei 会受到哪怕一点点像{i}她{/i}被重置时对他造成的那种打击吗？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk5
: Well...
lines.zh: 这个嘛……

lines.en: : Because I don’t think it would. And if that’s the case, maybe waiting this out really {i}is{/i} our best option.
lines.zh: 因为我觉得不会。既然如此，也许就这么等下去{i}真的{/i}是我们最好的选择。

lines.en: : What?...
lines.zh: 什么？……

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk6

: Well...think about it. If the original Maya is that far ahead of both you and me in terms of Sensei’s level of affection for her, bringing her {i}back{/i} would just put {i}us{/i} at a disadvantage. Wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: 你……想想看。如果原本的 Maya 在 Sensei 心里的好感度上领先我和你那么多，把她{i}带回来{/i}只会让我们{i}自己{/i}处于劣势。不是吗？

lines.en: : That’s...not really how I was looking at any of this. I just want my friend back and my future husband to come out of his hole.
lines.zh: 我……真不是这么看待这一切的。我只是想让我的朋友回来，让我未来的老公从他的洞里爬出来。

lines.en: : Sure. And I get that. I’d probably be doing the same exact thing if it was Miku who vanished instead of Maya.
lines.zh: 当然。我懂。如果消失的是 Miku 而不是 Maya，我大概也会做一模一样的事。

lines.en: : But try to look at things from my perspective right now. What would I {i}gain{/i} if Maya were to return to normal? She’s not even my friend. And {i}you’re{/i} not really my friend either.
lines.zh: 可你现在试着站在我的角度想想。如果 Maya 恢复正常，我能{i}得到{/i}什么？她连我朋友都算不上。而{i}你{/i}其实也不算我朋友。

lines.en: : That-

: Don’t bother actually responding to that question. The answer is even less time with Sensei and a lower ranked place in his ugly excuse for a heart. Which you’d {i}also{/i} be receiving in exchange for Maya.
lines.zh: 这个问题你不用真的回答。答案就是和 Sensei 相处的时间更少，在他那颗勉强算是心的丑东西里排位更低。而{i}你{/i}也会因为换回 Maya 而得到同样的待遇。

lines.en: : Assuming we actually {i}can{/i} bring her back, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是我们{i}真的能{/i}把她带回来。

lines.en: : Which we probably can’t because it would make her disappearance a lot less impactful and I can’t really imagine my apparent romance manga selling well with such flimsy plot devices.
lines.zh: 而我们大概做不到，因为那样她的消失就没那么有冲击力了，而且我真不觉得我这出爱情漫画靠这么单薄的剧情装置能卖得动。

lines.en: : Makoto...this isn’t some kind of game. Even if it doesn’t feel or look like it, this {i}is{/i} real life. Maya’s not some other heroine Sensei’s trying to pick up. She’s an actual person.
lines.zh: Makoto……这不是什么游戏。就算感觉上、看起来都不像，这{i}就是{/i}现实生活。Maya 不是 Sensei 想泡的哪个女主角。她是个活生生的人。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m not convinced this {i}is{/i} real life.
lines.zh: 老实说，我并不相信这{i}就是{/i}现实生活。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk7
: What?! But after all you’ve-
lines.zh: 什么？！可是在你经历了那么多——

lines.en: : Shh. You wanted to keep things quiet, didn’t you? Maya will hear you if you start yelling.
lines.zh: 嘘。你不是说要小声点吗？你一喊 Maya 就该听见了。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk8
: But, Makoto...how could you even say that after seeing an entire loop for yourself? Did you seriously not feel any pain or...{i}anything{/i} that whole time?
lines.zh: 可是，Makoto……你自己亲眼看过一整轮循环，怎么还能说出这种话？那段时间里你真的一点痛苦、或者{i}任何{/i}感觉都没有吗？

lines.en: : It’s precisely {i}because{/i} I’ve seen an “entire loop” that I can say I’m not convinced this is real life. “Real life” has consequences. People can die. {i}We{/i} can die in real life.
lines.zh: 正{i}因为{/i}我看过「一整轮循环」，我才能说我不相信这是现实生活。「现实生活」是有后果的。人会死。{i}我们{/i}在现实里是会死的。

lines.en: : But if we die here, we just start over. Don’t we? That makes this sound more like a video game. And I’ve never been great at video games, but I’m pretty sure there’s usually some kind of “goal” in them.
lines.zh: 可我们在这儿死了，就只是重新开始。不是吗？这么说起来这里更像电子游戏。我游戏打得不好，但我敢肯定游戏里通常都有某种「目标」。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk9
: And what would {i}our{/i} goal be if not competing for the heart of the man we all so obviously love? Why not just take the advantage that’s been handed to us and compete against one another?
lines.zh: 那么{i}我们{/i}的目标，除了争夺那个我们显然都爱着的男人的心之外，还能是什么？为什么不干脆接住送到手上的优势，互相竞争一场？

lines.en: : Because there’s nothing to compete {i}for{/i} if Sensei stays trapped in his house for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: 因为如果 Sensei 永远被困在自己家里，那就没什么可{i}争{/i}的了。

lines.en: : And between time never passing here and Ami being basically fucking insane, that might be exactly what happens.
lines.zh: 再加上这里时间从不流逝，Ami 又基本是个疯子，这种事还真有可能发生。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk10
: Then I guess we’ll have plenty of time to become friends before ultimately being forced to betray one another.
lines.zh: 那我想，在最终被迫互相背叛之前，我们有的是时间先成为朋友。

lines.en: : Is this...seriously what you’re like?
lines.zh: 你……真的就是这样的人吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure “what I’m like” anymore. But you know what I {i}am{/i} sure of? That Sensei’s going to be fine whether or not we do anything about it.
lines.zh: 我已经不太确定「我是什么样的人」了。但我{i}确实{/i}确定的是：不管我们做不做点什么，Sensei 都会没事的。

lines.en: : What I learned from my dad dying is that time doesn’t heal everything like people tell you. But it {i}does{/i} make it easier to stomach getting out of bed in the morning.
lines.zh: 我爸去世那件事让我明白，时间并不像人们说的那样能治愈一切。但它{i}确实{/i}能让你早上爬起来的时候不那么难受。

lines.en: : And Sensei has all the time in the world. Literally. So if there’s no strict time limit we need to have him normal again by, why not let him grieve for now so he can get up on his own one day?
lines.zh: 而 Sensei 拥有世界上全部的时间。字面意义上的。所以如果我们没有非让他恢复正常不可的硬性期限，为什么不让他先难过一阵子，好让他有朝一日自己站起来？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk11
: Hah...I don’t like debating with you. You’re too...rational. At least Maya would, like...{i}guess{/i} stuff when I argued with her. But you’re all about {i}facts{/i} and {i}logic{/i} and stuff.
lines.zh: 哈……我不喜欢跟你辩论。你太……讲理了。至少我跟 Maya 吵的时候，她还会{i}瞎猜{/i}一通。可你满脑子都是{i}事实{/i}和{i}逻辑{/i}之类的东西。

lines.en: : Those {i}are{/i} my strong suits, yes. And I’m sorry for putting everything a little bluntly — that’s just the way I’ve been looking at all of this.
lines.zh: 那{i}确实{/i}是我的强项。抱歉我把话说得有点直——我只是最近一直这么看待这一切。

lines.en: : I could always be convinced otherwise, though. After all, games aren’t very fun if the {i}only{/i} thing you do is rush for the end goal.
lines.zh: 不过我也不是不能被说服。毕竟，如果{i}只{/i}顾着冲向最终目标，游戏就不好玩了。

lines.en: : So how about {i}you{/i} tell me what your plans are since you obviously have some?
lines.zh: 那么{i}你{/i}来说说你有什么计划吧，你明显是有的。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk12
: Thank you. But please don’t try to destroy me with more logic once you hear them because I am hanging on by a thread right now and you’re literally the only person I have.
lines.zh: 谢谢。不过听完之后求你别再用逻辑来击溃我，因为我现在已经是靠一根线吊着了，而你真的算是我唯一剩下的人了。

lines.en: : Things not to say to a girl who just equated the world to one giant competition in which we will all have to betray each other.
lines.zh: 这话可不该对一个刚刚把世界说成一场所有人最终都得互相背叛的大型竞赛的女孩说。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk13
: Please. Proceed.
lines.zh: 请吧。继续。

lines.en: : You’re scary when you smile.
lines.zh: 你笑起来挺吓人的。

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk14
The scent of coconut assaulted the nasal passages of Ayane Amamiya as she moved closer to a girl that would [[probably] stab her in the back if it meant getting closer to her “goal.”
lines.zh: 椰子的香气冲进 Ayane Amamiya 的鼻腔，她正靠近一个[[大概]会为了离自己的「目标」更近一点而在背后捅她一刀的女孩。

lines.en: After all, this was a girl who, while remaining open to the idea of being convinced, had made her place and purpose clear for the first time since the passing of her father.
lines.zh: 毕竟，这是一个虽然仍愿意被说服、却第一次在父亲过世之后把立场和目的讲得清清楚楚的女孩。

lines.en: It was a liberating feeling for Makoto Miyamura, who had not felt “free” in quite some time. And the only thing that could make it better would be a penis stuffed inside of her.
lines.zh: 对 Makoto Miyamura 来说，这是一种解脱的感觉——她已经很久没有体会过「自由」了。而唯一能让事情更好的，就是有根鸡巴塞进她身体里。

lines.en: Unfortunately, Ayane Amamiya did not have a penis. She had a vagina.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，Ayane Amamiya 没有鸡巴。她有的是阴道。

lines.en: if makotolust30 == True:
And so Makoto Miyamura’s options were limited to: waiting, sex toys (this is the answer she would choose), or raping a man — which she had already done once before.
lines.zh: 于是 Makoto Miyamura 的选择只剩下了：等着、用性玩具（她会选这个），或者强奸一个男人——这种事她以前已经干过一次了。

lines.en: else:
And so Makoto Miyamura’s options were limited to: waiting, sex toys (this is the answer she would choose), or raping a man — a thing she didn’t want to do.
lines.zh: 于是 Makoto Miyamura 的选择只剩下了：等着、用性玩具（她会选这个），或者强奸一个男人——这是她不想做的事。

lines.en: Regardless of the desires this young, glasses-sporting girl held closest to her heart, a separate heart beating not far from her own belonging to the initial subject beat harder.
lines.zh: 不管这个戴眼镜的年轻女孩心底最深的欲望是什么，离她不远处的另一颗心脏——属于最初那个对象的——跳得更厉害。

lines.en: It beat faster and more passionately. And it also longed for a penis to be somewhere inside of its host body — but that wasn’t the main priority right now.
lines.zh: 它跳得更快、更热烈。它也渴望有一根鸡巴进入它主人的身体里的某个地方——不过那不是眼下最要紧的事。

lines.en: The main priority was convincing Makoto that they needed to win Ami’s trust rather than destroy her — as she had now begun to question the words of a mysterious girl presently fading from her mind.
lines.zh: 眼下最要紧的，是说服 Makoto：她们需要赢得 Ami 的信任，而不是毁掉她——因为她如今已开始怀疑那个正从她脑海中淡去的神秘女孩说过的话。

lines.en: When she opens her mouth, words come out instead of vomit. If only that had been the case in Lesions of Love Volume 0.35.0: The One With the Room.
lines.zh: 她一张嘴，吐出来的是话而不是呕吐物。要是《爱情病灶》第 0.35.0 卷：有房间的那一卷里也能这样就好了。

lines.en: : I think we should leave the party.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们该离开这个派对。

lines.en: : {i}I understand that you also long for a penis inside of you, but neither one of us possesses one. And so we should stay here instead.{/i} — she doesn’t say this, but she might as well have.
lines.zh: {i}我明白你也渴望有一根鸡巴在里面，可我们俩谁都没有。所以我们还是留在这儿吧。{/i}——这话她没说出口，但说了也差不多。

lines.en: : If I know Ami well, which I’m pretty sure I do, chances are she’s having her own Christmas party with Sensei right now since she’s definitely not coming to this one.
lines.zh: 如果我还算了解 Ami——我挺确定我了解——她这会儿八成正和 Sensei 办她自己的圣诞派对，毕竟这场她是绝对不会来的。

lines.en: : And I think if the two of us head there, two people she’s already familiar with and trusts to at least {i}some{/i} extent, she might let us join them.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得如果我们俩过去——两个她已经熟悉、至少{i}多少{/i}信得过的人——她说不定会让我们加入。

lines.en: : Is it just me or does that sound a little too easy? This is the same girl who’s refused to let {i}anyone{/i} see him since the two of them left the karaoke booth. Why would tonight be any different?
lines.zh: 是我多心还是这也太简单了？自从她和他离开 KTV 包厢之后，她可是{i}谁{/i}都不让见他。今晚凭什么就不一样了？

lines.en: : Because miracles {i}always{/i} happen on Christmas.
lines.zh: 因为奇迹{i}总是{/i}在圣诞节发生。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: 你他妈在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk15
: What?! It’s true! That’s like, the cornerstone of every great Christmas movie ever!
lines.zh: 什么？！这是真的啊！这可是每一部伟大的圣诞电影的基石！

lines.en: : Your amazing plan that you called both Maya and {i}me{/i} out to breakfast for was to turn our unbelievably weird and somewhat tragic tale into a {i}Christmas movie?{/i}
lines.zh: 你特意把 Maya 和{i}我{/i}叫出来吃早餐，就是为了把你那了不起的计划——把我们这个离谱又有点悲惨的故事变成一部{i}圣诞电影{/i}？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk16
: No. It was to harness the {i}power{/i} of Christmas movies and Christmas cheer to put an end to both Sensei’s sadness and Ami’s insanity so we can all live happily ever after.
lines.zh: 不是。是要借助圣诞电影和圣诞气氛的{i}力量{/i}，终结 Sensei 的悲伤和 Ami 的疯狂，好让我们所有人从此幸福地生活在一起。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, you’re just as broken as everybody else, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 天啊，你跟其他所有人一样不正常，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk17
: I’m out of ideas, okay?! I had so many when Maya was here and she never let me try them! But now that she {i}isn’t{/i} here, I can’t think of anything at all and it really, really sucks!
lines.zh: 我没办法了，行吗？！Maya 在的时候我有的是点子，可她一个都不让我试！现在她{i}不在{/i}了，我什么都想不出来，真的、真的糟透了！

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
lines.zh: 呃……喂？

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk18
: What’s this about me not being here? And why does it look like you two are about to make out?
lines.zh: 什么叫我不在这儿？还有，你们俩看起来怎么像是要接吻了？

lines.en: : Because Ayane doesn’t grasp the concept of personal space and {i}I{/i} am far too easygoing.
lines.zh: 因为 Ayane 完全不懂什么叫个人空间，而{i}我{/i}又太好说话了。

lines.en: : Easygoing?! You made our classroom sound like the Hunger Games just a few minutes ago and talked about how we’re all going to have to betray one another! That isn’t easygoing! It’s crazy!
lines.zh: 好说话？！你几分钟前还把我们教室说得像《饥饿游戏》一样，大谈我们最后都得互相背叛！这叫好说话？！这叫疯了！

lines.en: scene ayanemakxmastalk19
: What’s a hunger game? I want to play.
lines.zh: 饥饿游戏是什么？我也想玩。

lines.en: : When...did you two get so close?...
lines.zh: 你们俩……什么时候变得这么要好了？……

lines.en: : When Ayane grabbed me, obviously. Now, quick. Someone help. Before I am converted.
lines.zh: 当然是 Ayane 抓住我的时候。现在，快点。来个人救救我。趁我还没被感化。

lines.en: : Converted to what?! We’re both straight!
lines.zh: 感化成什么？！我们俩都是直女！

lines.en: : Everybody, look! First, it was Kirin and Noriko! Now Makoto and Ayane are gonna make out too!
lines.zh: 大家快看！先是 Kirin 和 Noriko！现在 Makoto 和 Ayane 也要亲上了！

lines.en: : We never kissed! And the entire idea of mistletoe is a lie perpetuated by first-century Celtic druids who falsely believed it led to increased fertility!
lines.zh: 我们根本没亲！而且槲寄生那一套根本就是骗局，是一世纪凯尔特德鲁伊散布的谎言，他们错误地以为它能提高生育能力！

lines.en: : Oi! You leave my people outta this!
lines.zh: 喂！别把我的人扯进来！

lines.en: $ springtime11 = True
jump springtime12
